channel.title: Projects on Jared Goronkin
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Jared Goronkin

item.title: Mosaic
item.description: A universal gameplay framework for Unity that enables full modularity in systems development. Leveraged by Echoes In The Mists

item.title: Echoes in the Mists
item.description: A full featured soulslike-in-an-evening built in 8 months by a 5-person core team. Powered by Mosaic and showcased at GDC and other conventions.

item.title: Procedural Terrain
item.description: A lightweight terrain generation tool using Perlin noise and animation curves to create hand-tuned environments in Unity.

item.title: Data Structure Debug Library
item.description: A C++ debug and visualization tool developed to help students in SUNY Poly’s CS 240 course learn datastructures and algorithms.

item.title: Scalar Field Visualization
item.description: A proof-of-concept system for terrain generation, supporting overhangs and caves, using marching cubes and 3D flow fields to avoid typical artifacts.

item.title: Marching Cube GPU
item.description: Real time scalar field visualization and noise generation in Unity, made to develop a deeper understanding of procedural generation.

item.title: Optimized Schooling Behavior
item.description: A boid simulation with obstacle avoidance, designer friendly pathing, and optimized for a game embeded in the web browser.
